reason: A visual manual control for deterministically selecting models and reasoning effort for in-process subagents on a per-session basis, with host-side request routing and persisted selections.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供可视化的子代理模型与推理强度选择，并按会话持久化设置。
summaries.en: Provides a visual per-session selector for subagent models and reasoning effort in DeepSeek Harness, with persisted routing settings.

capabilities: Provides a visual per-session selector for subagent models and reasoning effort
Overrides provider, model, and optional reasoning effort for in-process subagent requests
Persists session-specific model selections across restarts
